text:
Type: wool runner rug
Use: covering hallways and long floor areas; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, coastal
Materials: woven wool, flat textured weave
Colors: seafoam green, light sage, cream
Shape: long narrow runner, subtle speckled heathered texture, no pattern, flat low profile, light visual weight
Feel: calm, airy, natural
Goes with: white floors, light wood benches, natural fibers; coastal, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Contemporary Speckle Wool Runner Rug, 2' 3" x 7' 6", Seafoam
product.description: 100% Wool Imported Gradated tones of seafoam green give this runner a beautiful texture and a calming feel. Hand-tufted of 100% wool, this contemporary rug is durable and ready to blend with your existing styles. Contemporary style Hand-tufted in India of 100% wool Timeless look with durability for high-traffic areas 8' x 10'6" Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
